name: Westerns Warmup Riverside A 2026
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternsWarmupRiversideA2026#73009-competitor-responsibilities) tab. **This is a twin competition with [Westerns Warmup Riverside B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternsWarmupRiversideB2026). You may only sign up for ONE competition (A or B).** Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. **Food is NOT allowed in the venue. This competition is scheduled to take place before normal lunch hours.** This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
